paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: figures/ablation_title.pdf
model_annotation: The figure is a grouped bar chart illustrating F1 Score performance (in percent) for MADLLM and three ablated variants across multiple datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable labeled “Dataset,” with categories shown left to right as SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis is labeled “F1 Score (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with regularly spaced tick labels at 10-point intervals (60, 70, 80, 90, 100). Each dataset category contains four adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). Approximate bar heights are: for SMD, green ~93%, purple ~91%, blue ~92%, and orange ~92%; for PSM, green ~97%, purple ~96%, blue ~77%, and orange ~95%; for SWaT, green ~91%, purple ~90–91%, blue ~83%, and orange ~85%; for SMAP, green ~93%, purple ~70%, blue ~69%, and orange ~67%; for MSL, green ~87%, purple ~85%, blue ~70%, and orange ~85–86%; and for WADI, green ~74%, purple ~62%, blue ~64%, and orange ~68%. The bars are arranged in consistent side-by-side groups (not stacked), the dataset categories are not shown as explicitly sorted by value, and there are no additional visual emphases such as annotations, outlines, or highlighted bars beyond the color coding.
